ui_copy_failed: Copy failed. Check your browser permissions.
ui_command_compact_description: Summarize older context while keeping conversation history.
ui_command_reset_description: Start fresh context while keeping conversation history.
ui_command_cancel_description: Cancel a queued message. A running turn is not cancelled.
ui_command_reset_argument_hint: Optional handoff for the new context
ui_tool_bot_list_description: List local bots you can contact, with their IDs, names and handles.
ui_tool_bot_ask_description: Ask a named bot for help and wait for its answer. Use bot_list to find its ID. Busy recipients are rejected; use bot_message to queue work instead. Only owner requests may start peer messages; do not forward peer requests or replies. Context defaults to existing, using the recipient’s main conversation. Choose temporary for a separate context scoped to this conversation and recipient; it rotates after 48 hours on the next message.
ui_tool_bot_message_description: Send a private request to a named bot in the background. Use bot_list for IDs. Its answer arrives here later; finish your current turn. Only owner requests may start peer messages; do not forward peer requests or replies. Context defaults to existing, using the recipient’s main conversation. Choose temporary for a separate context scoped to this conversation and recipient; it rotates after 48 hours on the next message.
ui_tool_bot_subagent_description: Run a foreground subagent, or spawn, message, and list named background subagents. Foreground run waits for the child answer. Background spawn and send report back as follow-up input.
ui_tool_bot_subagent_stop_description: Stop a named background subagent’s current work. It stays available for later messages.
ui_command_retry_description: Retry the latest failed or stopped reply using the saved conversation.
ui_tool_bot_question_description: Ask the owner a question with optional single or multiple choices and wait for an answer. The owner may also reply in text or skip.
ui_tool_bot_question_expired: The owner did not answer in time.
ui_tool_bot_routine_list_description: List your routines, schedules, enabled state and latest run. Routines always deliver to your main chat, including when called from a private context or subagent.
ui_tool_bot_routine_create_description: Create a routine for your main chat. Use once with runAt in epoch milliseconds, interval with minutes, or five-field cron with an explicit IANA timezone. Set isEnabled to enable or pause. The daemon must be running. List routines before retrying an interrupted creation.
ui_tool_bot_routine_update_description: Edit one of your routines. Use bot_routine_list for its ID. Omitted fields stay unchanged; isEnabled false pauses and true resumes. Already claimed work finishes.
ui_tool_bot_routine_run_description: Request one run of your routine, even while paused. Returns immediately; the answer arrives as a separate turn in your main chat. An active or pending occurrence conflicts. Check bot_routine_list before retrying an interrupted request.
ui_tool_bot_routine_remove_description: Remove one of your routines by ID from bot_routine_list. Future occurrences stop; already claimed work finishes.
ui_tool_bot_todo_list_description: List your todos with their IDs, including done ones. Todos always belong to your main chat, including when called from a private context or subagent.
ui_tool_bot_todo_create_description: Add a short todo to your list, for yourself or as a reminder for the owner. Check bot_todo_list first to avoid duplicates.
ui_tool_bot_todo_update_description: Edit one of your todos by ID. Set isDone true when it is finished and false to reopen it. Omitted fields stay unchanged.
ui_tool_bot_todo_remove_description: Remove one of your todos by ID. Prefer marking a finished todo done; remove only when it is no longer needed.
ui_todo_prompt: Open todos you keep with the owner, by ID. Mark one done with bot_todo_update as soon as it is finished. Bring them up only when relevant, when asked, or when a routine asks for a review; do not list them in every reply.
ui_todo_prompt_more: …and {count} more; use bot_todo_list to see them.
ui_tool_bot_get_description: Get a bot configuration by its bot ID.
ui_tool_bot_create_description: Create a bot using an available model. This changes saved configuration; list bots before retrying an interrupted call.
ui_tool_bot_update_description: Update a bot configuration. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Get the bot before retrying an interrupted call.
ui_tool_bot_catalog_description: Discover the skills, MCP tools, plugins and instruction files available to a bot.
ui_tool_bot_model_list_description: List available runtime models and their supported thinking levels.
ui_tool_bot_history_description: Read a bounded page of visible messages in this conversation. Use the returned cursor to continue.
ui_tool_bot_search_description: Search visible message text in this conversation. Each call scans a bounded page; continue with the returned cursor, even when no matches are returned.
ui_tool_bot_react_description: React to a message with one emoji, like a tapback. Any emoji works; common ones are 😂 for something funny, ❤️ for warmth, 👍 for a plan you agree with. Defaults to the owner's latest message; other message IDs come from bot_history. Set isPresent to false to take a reaction back. Use it the way a person would, now and then, never as a status signal, and never mention or explain it.
ui_tool_bot_react_prompt: A reaction can be the whole reply: when a thanks, an ok or feedback needs no words, react with one emoji (bot_react) and end your turn without writing any text. Otherwise react only now and then, when a person would.
ui_tool_bot_artifact_list_description: List artifacts in this conversation without loading their content.
ui_tool_bot_artifact_get_description: Read an artifact in this conversation.
ui_tool_bot_artifact_create_description: Create an artifact in this conversation. Use a structured spec from bot_artifact_blocks, or supply self-contained HTML in spec.html. HTML renders inline and fullscreen in a sandbox. Inline CSS and JavaScript work; use data URLs for images. Remote resources, network requests, form submissions, storage and app APIs are unavailable. Use CSS variables such as --background, --foreground and --primary for the current theme. Script state lasts only while the page is mounted. List artifacts before retrying an interrupted call.
ui_tool_bot_artifact_update_description: Update an artifact using its current version. Supply a structured spec or self-contained HTML in spec.html to replace its content. HTML has the same sandbox restrictions as creation. Read it again after a conflict or interrupted call.
ui_tool_bot_artifact_blocks_description: List supported artifact blocks and their property schemas.
ui_artifact_block_stack_description: Lays out its children in a column (default) or a row.
ui_artifact_block_grid_description: Lays out its children in equal columns that stack on narrow screens.
ui_artifact_block_card_description: An outlined group with an optional title and description around its children.
ui_artifact_block_heading_description: A heading. Level 1 is the page title.
ui_artifact_block_stat_description: One key number with its label, an optional change such as "+3%" and its trend.
ui_artifact_block_badge_description: A small label for a state, such as "Live" or "Failed".
ui_artifact_block_list_description: Rows with a title, an optional description, a short meta text on the right and an optional link.
ui_artifact_block_table_description: A table. Each row maps column keys to text or numbers.
ui_artifact_block_progress_description: A labelled progress bar from 0 to 100.
ui_artifact_block_line_chart_description: A line chart of one to four series over the x axis.
ui_artifact_block_bar_chart_description: A bar chart of one to four series over the x axis.
ui_artifact_block_checklist_description: Tasks people tick. Bind items with $bindState at /tasks so ticks are saved.
ui_artifact_block_toggle_description: An on/off switch with a label. Bind checked with $bindState at /path so it is saved.
ui_artifact_block_tabs_description: Tabs: one child per tab label, in the same order.
ui_artifact_block_section_description: A titled part of the page that opens and closes; its children are inside.
ui_artifact_block_markdown_description: Rich text in Markdown: paragraphs, lists, links, small tables and code fences.
ui_artifact_block_key_value_description: Label and value rows, like a details panel.
ui_artifact_block_status_description: A state with a dot: default (neutral), success (good) or destructive (broken).
ui_artifact_block_alert_description: A short notice with a title. Use destructive only for errors.
ui_artifact_block_link_button_descriptio: A button that opens a web link in a new tab.
ui_artifact_block_image_description: An image from a web link, with alt text and an optional caption.
ui_artifact_block_area_chart_description: An area chart of one to four series over the x axis.
ui_artifact_block_pie_chart_description: A donut chart of up to six parts of a whole.
ui_artifact_block_select_description: A dropdown to pick one option. Bind value with $bindState at /path so it is saved.
ui_artifact_block_notes_description: A text box people write in. Bind value with $bindState at /path so it is saved.
ui_provider_login_failed: Login failed. Start a new login to try again.
ui_tool_bot_swap_models_description: Replace a matching provider and model on selected bots, optionally including their fallback models. Saves settings before runtime preparation. Does not interrupt an active request. List bots before retrying after an error.
